chunks: Ibn Mahbub, from Nuʿaym ibn Ibrahim, from ʿAbbad al-Basri, from Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad عليه السلام, who said:
If a man slanders another man and says, “You indeed do the deed of the people of Lut, you have intercourse with men,” he said: “He is to be flogged with the hadd of the slanderer, eighty lashes.”

key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً: eighty lashes as the prescribed punishment
key_terms.حَدَّ الْقَاذِفِ: the fixed legal punishment for the slanderer
key_terms.عَمَلَ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ: the deed associated with the people of Lut
key_terms.قَذَفَ: falsely accused or slandered someone with a sexual accusation

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for falsely accusing someone of the deed of the people of Lut in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling for falsely accusing a man of engaging in the deed of the people of Lut. The one who makes such an accusation is subject to the hadd punishment of qadhf, which is eighty lashes.
